san-juan-skyway-durango-lizard-head-pass.title: San Juan Skyway: Durango to Lizard Head Pass
san-juan-skyway-durango-lizard-head-pass.slogan: Durango to Lizard Head Pass, over 3358 m · one way, about 227 km back to the start

waypoints.name: Durango
waypoints.advice: Durango is where the day begins. Next is Silverton.

waypoints.name: Silverton
waypoints.advice: Silverton comes up 45 km in. Next is Red Mountain Pass.

waypoints.name: Red Mountain Pass
waypoints.advice: 91 km in you reach Red Mountain Pass. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Ouray, mostly downhill.

waypoints.name: Ouray
waypoints.advice: Ouray, about halfway. Next is Telluride.

waypoints.name: Telluride
waypoints.advice: Telluride sits at 182 km, late in the day. Next is Lizard Head Pass.

waypoints.name: Lizard Head Pass
waypoints.advice: The route ends here after 227 km.

sections.advice: Durango → Silverton is 78 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.
Silverton → Red Mountain Pass climbs about 3358 m in 13 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Red Mountain Pass → Ouray drops about 3358 m over 18 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Ouray → Telluride is 19 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Telluride → Lizard Head Pass climbs about 3116 m in 21 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: The last of the trees go and the road runs out onto open ground. The summit sits at 3358 m, and what surrounds it is rock, weather and distance — cold comes early up here and stays late. Ride it with something in reserve: the summit is not the end of the work, only the middle of it.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Million Dollar Highway
scenicChapters.narrative: For 29 km this is Million Dollar Highway, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

san-juan-skyway-durango-lizard-head-pass.story: A one-way ride of 227 km, Durango to Mountain Village - roughly 3 h 18 in the saddle. The stops in between: Silverton, Red Mountain Pass, Ouray and Telluride. The highest point is about 3,600 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
